claims.text: Citing point 15 of Article 109 of the RSFSR Constitution, the RSFSR Supreme Soviet ratifies the Agreement between the Republic of Belarus, the Russian Federation (RSFSR) and Ukraine on the creation of the Commonwealth of Independent States, signed at Minsk on 8 December 1991 (point 1). To give effect to Article 11 of the Agreement, it provides that until the corresponding RSFSR laws are adopted, norms of the former USSR apply in the RSFSR insofar as they do not contradict the RSFSR Constitution, RSFSR legislation and the Agreement (point 2). Signed R. I. Khasbulatov, Chairman of the RSFSR Supreme Soviet, Moscow, House of Soviets of the RSFSR, 12 December 1991, No. 2014-I.
claims.locator: Preamble, points 1-3; signature and date block
claims.uncertainty: Ratification by one party, the RSFSR, on 12 December, separate from the 8 December signature. The resolution gives no entry-into-force date of its own and no date of deposit or notification; the Alma-Ata Protocol's rule that the Agreement enters into force for each party on ratification was signed later, on 21 December. The Belarus and Ukraine ratifications were not reviewed. An act of an RSFSR body, not of a USSR organ.

scope_note: RSFSR ratification of the Minsk Agreement, filed in this packet because it dates the Agreement's effect for one party and qualifies Article 11. Gazette citation: Vedomosti 1991 No. 51, art. 1798. The portal text prints the republic's name without 'Soviet' in its preamble ('Российской Федеративной Социалистической Республики'); the signed original reads the full name.
